items.text:
Requires a bit more time to develop
The devs are creating more like a system for a game, rather than the game itself, so it has depth but lacks content.

But for 20€ and devs updating it and responding in the forums actively? I think its a good investment. Even more if they increase the price post early access.
items.text_zh:
需要更多时间来开发
开发者们更像是在为一款游戏创建一个系统，而不是游戏本身，所以它有深度但缺乏内容。

但20欧元，而且开发者还在更新它并在论坛里积极回复？我觉得这是一笔不错的投资。如果他们能在抢先体验后提高价格，那就更值了。
